module_summary: Two-stage pipelined unsigned shift-and-add multiplier: gated shifted partial products are summed pairwise into stage-1 registers, then added into registered mul_out.

anchors.name: mul_result
anchors.why: Partial products: mul_a shifted by i when mul_b[i] set, feeding stage-1 adders.

anchors.name: sum_tmp1
anchors.why: Stage-1 register of partial-product pair sums; sum_tmp2 is its twin.

anchors.name: mul_out
anchors.why: Stage-2 registered product, sum of stage-1 registers.

anchors.name: mul_a
anchors.why: Multiplicand, zero-extended and shifted into partial products.

anchors.name: mul_b
anchors.why: Multiplier; each bit gates one partial product.

groups.name: partial_products
groups.description: Zero-extend mul_a and generate bit-gated shifted partial products.

groups.name: stage1_adders
groups.description: Registers pairwise sums of the four partial products.

groups.name: stage2_output
groups.description: Adds stage-1 sums into registered product.
